title: Add Relationship Engine v1 fully lease-fenced DB contract
purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
## Purpose
Record the production Relationship Engine v1 DB contract in GitHub so application integration is safe across multiple workers and every permanent Relationship mutation is fenced by the active lease token.

## Distributed worker contract
- per-user + processing-version lease ownership
- oldest unfinished post-cutover canonical turn only
- explicit renew / release
- all permanent Relationship writes require the live lease token
- Pattern consumption unique across request IDs

## Full mutation fencing
The DB contract fences:
- `advance_misaki_relationship_processing_v2`
- `record_misaki_relationship_evidence_v2`
- `upsert_misaki_relationship_episode_v2`
- `upsert_misaki_relationship_pattern_v2`
- `upsert_misaki_relationship_critical_pending_v2`
- `advance_misaki_relationship_critical_pending_v2`
- `import_misaki_temporary_relationship_v2`
- `apply_misaki_relationship_state_v2`
- `apply_misaki_relationship_critical_event_v2`

Every v2 mutation validates the current lease row inside the same DB transaction as its canonical write.

## Legacy bypass closure
The intermediate/import v2 RPCs now contain their canonical write logic directly; they no longer call the legacy v1 mutation RPCs.
`service_role` EXECUTE has been revoked from all legacy permanent Relationship mutation v1 RPCs, so application code cannot bypass lease fencing even by accidentally calling an old contract.

## Security boundary
- SECURITY INVOKER
- v2 application mutation execution restricted to `service_role`
- `anon` / `authenticated` cannot execute Relationship mutation RPCs
- legacy v1 mutation RPCs are not executable by `service_role`
- no direct Relationship table writes from application code

## Verification
Production DB matches this contract.
Verified:
- v1 mutation EXECUTE = false for service_role
- v2 mutation EXECUTE = true for service_role
- out-of-order claim rejection
- stale/final/intermediate lease rejection
- cross-request Pattern double-consumption rejection
- no new SECURITY DEFINER exposure

No application integration changes are included in this PR.

Add distributed Relationship Engine worker contract
Fence all Relationship Engine writes with lease tokens
Remove legacy Relationship Engine write bypasses
Record direct v2 Relationship Engine write contract

curated.summary: Relationship Engine v1の正本DB契約を追加し、リースで重複処理や古い書込みを保護。
curated.conclusion: 引継ぎ資料にはEvidence、Episode、Pattern、Critical Pending、5長期軸、明示的関係状態、版番号、処理台帳とRPC契約が記載されている。これは既存のDB基盤を再設計しないための根拠。過去資料の本番適用記述と、今回の本番状態確認は分離する。親密さを恋愛・恋人状態と同一視せず、経過時間だけで感情を捏造しない。
